packs.name: Pepe's Experience Tome
packs.description: Introduces Crystallized Lapis and the Experience Tome, an item that lets you bank up to 64 levels of experience for safekeeping and withdraw them whenever you need a quick level boost. Both are found as rare loot hidden within ancient structures, rewarding players who explore off the beaten path.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Hotbar Refiller
packs.description: Keeps your hotbar combat-ready by automatically swapping in a fresh tool or topping up a depleted block stack from your inventory the instant one runs out, removing the need to pause and manually restock mid-fight or mid-build.
packs.author: PepeOnMCBE

packs.name: Pepe's Item Magnet Addon
packs.description: Adds a craftable Magnet item that instantly draws every dropped item within a 10-block radius directly to you, making item collection after mob farming, mining, or PvP encounters effortless.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Void Totem
packs.description: Adds the Void Totem, a protective charm that can be held in either hand to survive an otherwise fatal fall into the void, giving players a second chance when a build goes wrong or a jump comes up short.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Allay Client
packs.description: Named after the Allay, this release of the client brought a further round of polish and refinement to the experience, tightening up the feature set and interface established by earlier versions.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Glacier Client
packs.description: The current flagship client and home base of Glacier Productions, built to bring together the full range of performance, visual, and quality-of-life improvements the team has developed across its history.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Optifine by Zephyx
packs.description: An early Optifine-branded release built during the client's original run under the name Zephyx, before the project rebranded to Pepe and later evolved into the Glacier Client lineage.
packs.author: Zephyx

packs.name: Pepe Client
packs.description: Where it all started: the very first Minecraft Bedrock client released under the Pepe name, laying the groundwork for every client that followed in this collection.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Project Future
packs.description: An experimental rebrand built to explore new features and a new creative direction for the client line, testing ideas that would go on to shape later releases.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Project Light
packs.description: A bridge release positioned between major versions, exploring a lighter-weight client experience with a leaner feature set and reduced overhead.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Solar Client
packs.description: Focused squarely on visuals and performance, this release continues the client's ongoing evolution with refined rendering and a smoother overall feel.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Sulphur Client
packs.description: Another step in the client's ongoing rebrand and feature journey, building on the foundation of previous releases while introducing its own set of refinements.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Void Client
packs.description: The client that directly followed Pepe Client, marking an early and important step in refining the formula that later releases would build upon.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Wind Client
packs.description: A lighter, faster iteration built on the lessons learned from Void Client, trimming excess and sharpening performance for a snappier experience.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Charged Overlay Pack
packs.description: Adds a charged particle-style overlay effect to your character, giving combat and movement a bit of extra visual flair without altering gameplay.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Halo Pack
packs.description: Adds a customizable halo effect that hovers above your character, a simple cosmetic touch for players who want to stand out in a crowd.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Assets Pack
packs.description: The shared foundation every other Pepe's Pack builds on: common textures, UI variables, and compatibility patches consolidated in one place. Must be enabled and sorted above every other Pepe's Pack to work correctly.
packs.author: Pepe

versions.changelog: Added support for the Better Armor Bar pack, and fixed a hand model issue on cross-platform servers.
Added support for the Debug HUD pack, and fixed a paperdoll rendering issue.
Added support for the Shiny Pots pack, including configurable item IDs.
Added support for the Waypoints+ pack. Fixed an intermittent issue affecting the FPS Counter.
Added support and configuration variables for the Death Coords and Better Hover Text packs.
Fixed an intermittent hand-rendering issue, and fixed the Clock & Compass HUD failing to render (requires Clock & Compass HUD v1.0.1 or later).
Added support for the Clock & Compass HUD pack. Resolved a range of visual issues, and added a variable to toggle the Level Calculator's visibility.
Added support for the Speedometer pack. Fixed an issue causing some zombie villagers to fail to load.

notice.title: A Must-Have for All Packs!
notice.intro: To ensure all your Pepe's Packs load and work perfectly, you must enable and place the Pepe's Pack Assets pack above all other packs in your load order.
notice.instruction: Download and Import it like a regular pack and make sure it's on top of the list.
notice.featuresTitle: What Does the Assets Pack Do?
notice.featuresIntro: This essential pack provides the core foundation for all other Pepe's Packs:

features.title: Seamless Compatibility
features.text: It makes every pack compatible with each other, ensuring they work together without issues.

features.title: Shared Resources
features.text: It contains crucial assets that multiple packs need, preventing duplication and keeping things tidy.

features.title: Full Customization
features.text: It allows you to easily configure settings across all your packs from one central place.

notice.critical: Your game will crash if the Pepe's Pack Assets isn't enabled! Don't forget to activate it!

packs.name: Pepe's ArmorHUD
packs.description: Displays the armor you're currently wearing as compact icons directly on the HUD, so you can check your protection at a glance without opening your inventory.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Better Armor Bar
packs.description: Recolors the HUD armor bar to reflect your equipped armor's material, letting you read your protection level at a glance instead of counting icons.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Better Coordinates
packs.description: Adds a complete coordinate readout to the HUD, covering overworld, chunk, and Nether coordinates together so you always know exactly where you stand.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Better Hover Text
packs.description: Enriches inventory tooltips with the detail serious players actually want: exact durability values, technical item and aux IDs, and identification of Suspicious Stew effects.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Clock & Compass HUD
packs.description: Displays a compact clock and compass readout directly on the HUD, so you always know the time of day and the direction you're facing without checking your inventory.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Death Coords
packs.description: Captures and displays your exact coordinates the moment you die, so you never lose track of where your items dropped and can recover them with confidence.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Debug HUD
packs.description: A clean, minimal debug overlay showing only the information you actually want. Press F8 to toggle it instantly with keyboard and mouse.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's DirectionHUD
packs.description: Adds a compact heading indicator to the HUD, showing the exact cardinal direction you're facing at all times.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Durability Viewer
packs.description: Displays item durability directly on-screen in a clean, easy-to-read readout, so you always know how much life your tools and armor have left.
packs.author: PepeOnMinecraft

packs.name: Pepe's Force Spectator
packs.description: Forced a first-person spectator camera on death, letting you watch the action unfold before respawning. This pack has since been discontinued and is no longer maintained.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's FPS Counter
packs.description: A lightweight, accurate FPS counter for your HUD, letting you keep a constant eye on performance while you play without any added overhead.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's InventoryHUD
packs.description: Mirrors the contents of your inventory onto the HUD in real time, so you can check what you're carrying without ever opening a menu.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Level Calculator
packs.description: Calculates exactly how much experience you need to reach your next level and displays it directly on the HUD, taking the guesswork out of grinding XP.
packs.author: PepeOnMinecraft

packs.name: Pepe's OffhandHUD
packs.description: Shows the item currently held in your offhand right on the HUD, displayed alongside your main hand for a complete picture of your loadout.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Speedometer
packs.description: Tracks and displays your current movement speed on the HUD in real time, handy for elytra flight, sprinting, and speedrun-style play.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Status Effect HUD
packs.description: Displayed your active potion effects and their remaining duration directly on the HUD. This pack has since been discontinued and is no longer maintained.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Waypoints+
packs.description: A full waypoint system built for practical navigation: set markers by sneaking and clicking, automatically drop a marker at your death location, and toggle a chroma-key greenscreen mode, all through simple sneak gestures.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Animated Crop Growth Highlighter
packs.description: Highlights nearby crops with an animated overlay that reflects their current growth stage, making it easy to spot exactly which crops are ready to harvest at a glance.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Anvil Damage Indicator
packs.description: Adds a clear visual indicator to the anvil interface showing exactly how much durability damage an enchant or repair will cost before you commit to it.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Armor Hider
packs.description: Lets you hide individual pieces of equipped armor from view while keeping their full protective stats and enchantments active, so your character's look stays exactly how you want it.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Bundle Item Counter
packs.description: Adds a live item count directly onto bundle icons, so you can see how full each bundle is without needing to open it and inspect its contents.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Dynamic 3rd Person Crosshair
packs.description: Adds a proper crosshair to third-person camera mode that tracks your aim accurately, making third-person play far more precise for building, combat, and interaction.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Shiny Pots
packs.description: Gives decorated pots a subtle shine effect, making them easier to spot amid clutter and adding a small extra bit of visual polish to your builds.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Spinning Projectiles
packs.description: Adds a smooth spinning animation to thrown and shot projectiles in flight, giving arrows, tridents, and other thrown items a bit more visual flair.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Pepe's Time Changer
packs.description: Adds simple in-game controls to set the world time instantly, saving you from typing out commands whenever you want to skip to day, night, or a specific time.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: Glacier Client Website
packs.description: The official Glacier Client website, serving as the central home for the client's downloads, changelogs, and the latest news from the Glacier Productions team.
packs.author: Pepe

packs.name: MCA Glacier Client
packs.description: The MCA subdomain supporting Glacier Client, part of the wider Glacier Productions web ecosystem that powers the project's online presence.
packs.author: Pepe
